t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pairs of gnomes always come in the same colours.orange, red, blue and green lead to bright forestpurple, pink, yellow and brown lead to dark forestnumber of mushrooms vary all the time, but need to see which forest contains the most mushrooms so I can choose only those gnome colours.

vb_textbox.text: Hello!!Gnomes will always appear in pairs, and those won't change throughout the game: orange & brown, blue & purple, pink & green and red & yellow.There are 2 forests you can enter: the dark forest and the bright forest.Gnomes orange, red, blue and green will lead to the bright forest.Gnomes purple, pink, brown and yellow will lead to the dark forest.Their hat sizes don't matter for anything so ignore those.Lastly, try to stick to a forest that has the most mushrooms, if those numbers beginning to drop you can change to the other forest to see if there's more mushrooms there.Good luck!
